title: DiffNash: Finding Nash Equilibrium in High-Dimensional Continuous Action Spaces with Diffusion Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.15932v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computing equilibria in high-dimensional continuous games requires learning and representing rich, multi-modal strategy distributions, something conventional neural policies struggle to achieve. Diffusion models offer a natural solution, but standard diffusion training requires direct samples from a fixed target distribution, which are generally unavailable under iterative game-solving updates. We propose a diffusion-based framework for equilibrium computation that enables diffusion-based variants of Online Mirror Descent (OMD) and Fictitious Play (FP). Our approach derives a reweighted score-matching objective that trains diffusion policies without requiring direct samples from each updated policy. Our main method, DiffNash, combines the fast convergence of OMD with the sample efficiency of FP by reusing past actions through a replay buffer. To correct the resulting distribution shift from sample reuse, we derive an unbiased estimator

translated_title: DiffNash：利用扩散策略在高维连续动作空间中寻找纳什均衡
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.15932v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在高维连续博弈中计算均衡需要学习和表示丰富的、多模态的策略分布，这是传统神经策略难以实现的。扩散模型为此提供了一个自然的解决方案，但标准的扩散训练需要来自固定目标分布的直接样本，而在迭代博弈求解的更新过程中，这些样本通常是不可获得的。我们提出了一个基于扩散的均衡计算框架，实现了在线镜像下降（OMD）和虚拟对弈（FP）的扩散版本。我们的方法推导出了一个重加权的分数匹配目标，无需获取每个更新策略的直接样本即可训练扩散策略。我们的主要方法 DiffNash 通过重放缓冲区重用过去的动作，将 OMD 的快速收敛性与 FP 的样本效率相结合。为了纠正样本重用所导致的分布偏移，我们推导出了一个无偏估计器
tldr: 该论文提出基于扩散模型的DiffNash框架，通过重加权分数匹配目标训练扩散策略，并结合在线镜像下降与虚拟对弈的优势，实现在高维连续动作空间中高效求解纳什均衡。
